verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents custom metadata or property templates on files, and never documents an API to set or query such metadata. The closest items are adjacent features that do not deliver a developer-defined schema settable and queryable via API: AI auto-tagging of similar documents, OCR-based classification, natural-language AI search, and MCP content querying.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API
